digest.component_or_area: LLM gate cost analysis and ops observability
propositions: Mean cost per completed ticket is 11.85 dollars, with per-gate costs: plan-review 3.02, code-review 1.42, completion-verifier 2.24 dollars per run.

Code-review severity axes are inert because blocking is routed at the criterion level (disabled for 98.2% of findings) and thresholds are unreachable, not because the reviewer finds little (2.48 findings/run observed).
Haiku completion-verification achieves parity with Sonnet at 22/22 accuracy only as a backup; Sonnet remains primary; Nova models disqualified by false accepts on operator-attestation cases.

Deprecated single-pass review surfaces and REBAR_LLM_MODEL are candidates for removal in a v0.12.0 breaking window, but are not yet removable without registry annotation and one-release floor compliance.

Two new probe defects in infra/scripts/observability.sh fabricate metric counts (cold-start seeding and over-broad pattern matching), causing false alarm firings for voter_errors and merge_change_errors.

Four DEPLOY_DEFER_MAX bound-exceeded review interrupts on 2026-08-12 indicate the deferral budget is marginally undersized for current review durations, requiring a bound raise rather than alarm tuning.
